title: Data use & farmer privacy

points.detail: Soil readings, microclimate data, and aerial field boundaries.
Directly on the edge gateway device and laptop IndexedDB.
Kept for one crop season unless deleted by the operator.
Farmer telemetry is never sold or shared with commercial third parties.
Explicit written or vernacular audio consent before initial ingestion.

legalNote: Compliance note: Review data fiduciary obligations under the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023 with qualified legal counsel before pilot deployment.
